# Jason Shprintz

> Personal portfolio of Jason Shprintz, a software developer in Las Vegas, Nevada building production-grade web applications in React and TypeScript, with a focus on performance, clarity and the details users feel but rarely name.

Open to product engineering roles and a small number of contract builds each year. Also runs [Toastbyte Studios](https://toastbyte.studio), an independent software studio building web and mobile products end to end.

## Selected Work

- [GitAll](https://gitall.app): A unified contribution heatmap viewer aggregating activity from GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket and Gitea/Forgejo into a single side-by-side or merged view. Implements OAuth 2.0 with PKCE across four providers without a library, with AES-GCM encrypted session cookies, and serves embeddable SVG heatmaps for READMEs. Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Cloudflare Workers, D1, Vitest.
- [Alley Admin](https://alleyadmin.app): Web-based bowling league management replacing the aging desktop software league secretaries rely on. Rosters, digital scorekeeping, USBC-compliant handicap calculation, standings, scheduling and tournament brackets in one browser app. Astro, TypeScript, Cloudflare Workers, D1, Cloudflare Pages.
- [Dynastiest League](https://dynastiestleague.com): A dynasty fantasy football platform with an AI trade analyzer at its core. A scheduled Cloudflare Worker polls the Sleeper API every five minutes, generates grades and commentary for new trades via the Anthropic API, and caches them in D1 keyed on transaction ID so every visitor sees one consistent analysis. React, TypeScript, MobX, Vite, Cloudflare Workers, D1, Anthropic API.
- [Toastbyte Studios](https://toastbyte.studio): An independent software studio building web and mobile products end to end, from React Native apps to Cloudflare-hosted web platforms and Model Context Protocol services.

## Skills

- Frontend: React, TypeScript, Next.js, Astro, MobX, Vite, Tailwind CSS, styled-components
- Backend and infrastructure: Cloudflare Workers, D1, Cloudflare Pages, OAuth 2.0, Node.js
- Practices: performance and Core Web Vitals, accessibility, automated CI, end-to-end delivery
